AxTableField.Name: Enabled
AxTableField.HelpText: The daily batch job removes the D365FO records below once they are older than their days.
AxTableField.Label: Clean up D365FO

AxTableField.Name: DeviceCleanup
AxTableField.HelpText: Each handheld removes its own old records below, once a day. It picks the change up within minutes.
AxTableField.Label: Clean up handhelds

AxTableField.Name: PostQueueRegisteredDays
AxTableField.HelpText: Days a registered posting stays in the posting queue. Receiving reads the queue, so it slows as it grows. 0: never.
AxTableField.Label: Registered postings

AxTableField.Name: PostQueueFailedDays
AxTableField.HelpText: Days a failed posting stays in the posting queue. 0: never.
AxTableField.Label: Failed postings

AxTableField.Name: SignInLogDays
AxTableField.HelpText: Days a sign-in stays in the Mobile sign-in log. 0: never.
AxTableField.Label: Sign-in log

AxTableField.Name: FeedbackClosedDays
AxTableField.HelpText: Days feedback marked Done or Won't do stays (from when it was sent). 0: never.
AxTableField.Label: Closed feedback

AxTableField.Name: CountStageDays
AxTableField.HelpText: Days the counted lines of a transferred or cancelled stock count stay in the control center. The count itself stays. 0: never.
AxTableField.Label: Transferred counts

AxTableField.Name: DeviceWorkStaleDays
AxTableField.HelpText: Days without a report before a handheld's unsent work is marked Device not seen on Mobile unsent work. Nothing is deleted. 0: never.
AxTableField.Label: Unsent work - device not seen

AxTableField.Name: DeviceFinishedJournalDays
AxTableField.HelpText: Days a submitted or posted counting journal stays on the handheld. 0: never.
AxTableField.Label: Finished counting journals

AxTableField.Name: DeviceOrderHistoryDays
AxTableField.HelpText: Days an order created or refused stays in the handheld's list. Orders still waiting stay. 0: never.
AxTableField.Label: Created orders list

AxTableField.Name: DeviceOldWorkDays
AxTableField.HelpText: Days an untouched unfinished job, or a refused posting, stays on the handheld. It is kept in Mobile unsent work (Archived) before it is removed from the device. 0: never.
AxTableField.Label: Old unfinished work
